stories.headline: Base gains 8.87pp stablecoin market share as daily transactions exceed 10M; Circle Gateway enabling sub-500ms USDC liquidity on Base
stories.relevance: Base active addresses 430K-475K with 10M+ daily transactions; Circle Gateway launched July 2025 providing instant cross-chain USDC liquidity
stories.data_connection: q3_chain_dominance: Base market share +8.87pp to 33.25%, volume up 65.6% — directly driven by Base ecosystem expansion and Circle's infrastructure

stories.headline: CLARITY Act stalemate: JPMorgan's Dimon vs crypto firms over stablecoin rewards escalates; NCUA proposes GENIUS Act implementation rules
stories.relevance: CLARITY Act stalled in Congress; NCUA comment period for GENIUS Act rules closes July 17, 2026 — regulatory uncertainty continuing post-GENIUS Act signing
stories.data_connection: q3_chain_dominance: regulatory uncertainty may be dampening Ethereum institutional volume (-7.42pp share) while Base and non-US chains absorb flows

stories.headline: USDC overtakes USDT in institutional adoption: 86% of institutions plan to use USDC in 2026; stablecoin transactions hit record $33T led by USDC ($18.3T)
stories.relevance: USDC posted $18.3T vs USDT $13.3T in 2025; institutional preference shifting toward USDC due to GENIUS Act compliance framework
stories.data_connection: q1_summary (token-level volume): explains relative USDC vs USDT volume distribution and any USDC share gains visible in weekly data

stories.headline: TRON processes $21B daily stablecoin volume across 2.2M transactions; competes with Ethereum for #1 stablecoin supply position at $91B market cap
stories.relevance: Tron stablecoin supply grew $6.1B YTD to $86.6B; TRON settles ~50% of global USDT volume and ~30% of all stablecoin activity
stories.data_connection: q3_chain_dominance and q4_p2p_sizing: TRON's P2P dominance and high transfer counts explain its outsized presence in P2P sizing and chain dominance metrics

stories.headline: Coinbase Commerce halts service to non-US/Singapore merchants (March 31, 2026); global crypto payment gateways market reaches $2.39B with 25M merchants accepting crypto
stories.relevance: Coinbase Commerce exit from global markets reshapes merchant payment flows; stablecoins now 82% of all crypto payment gateway transactions with USDT at 33% merchant share
stories.data_connection: q2_usage_heatmap / q2_non_defi: merchant payment use-case volumes and non-DeFi transaction breakdown may reflect the Coinbase Commerce restructuring impact
